evidence.notes: Built feed(10 kg/s water, 298.15 K, 1 bar) -> pump(outlet 11 bar, eff 70%) -> product. solve() ok=true, mass_rel_err=0, energy_rel_err~7.6e-10. Read shaft power from read_unit(P1) and T_out from product stream.

Built distillation_column (20 stages, feed at stage 10, R=2, bottoms=75 mol/s, top_P=1 atm) with 50/50 EtOH/water feed at 300K/1atm using NRTL. Qc/Qr read from Col1's attached energy streams. Mass rel err ~1.5e-7, energy rel err ~1.3e-12.

Built Feed(100 mol/s, 300 K, 50 bar, 85/7/4/2% C1/C2/C3/nC4 + 2% CO2, Peng-Robinson) -> compressor K1 (60 bar, 75% adiabatic eff) -> cooler E1 (outlet 300 K). Read T from CompOut, W from K1 duty, Q from E1 duty. Max residuals: mass ~0, energy ~1e-9.

Compressor K1 (Peng-Robinson), natural gas feed 100 mol/s, 300 K, 50 bar -> 60 bar, polytropic_eff_pct=75. Read duty_or_power_kW, adiabatic_eff_pct, polytropic_eff_pct from read_unit and T_K from product stream. mass_rel_err=0, compound_max_rel_err~1.7e-16, energy_rel_err~6.2e-8.

CH4+air mixer -> adiabatic conversion reactor (CH4+2O2->CO2+2H2O, 100% conversion, no dissociation), Peng-Robinson. Basis: 1 mol/s CH4, air 21% O2/79% N2, 298.15K/1atm. Stoich air=9.5238 mol/s gives T=2339.43K; sweep+solve verification found air=14.165 mol/s (48.73% excess) gives FlueGas T=1799.997K (mass/energy residuals ~1e-8 to 1e-15).

Pump unit: feed 10 kg/s water, 298.15 K, 1 bar -> 11 bar, efficiency_pct=70. Solved ok=true, mass/energy residuals ~0. Read shaft power from P1 (power_kW=14.328). Margin 14.328*1.15=16.47 kW -> next IEC size up from list is 18.5 kW.
timeout after 600 s

Built 4-stage compressor train (K1..K4, equal ratio r=50^(1/4)=2.659, intercooled to 300K between stages) plus a single-stage sweep to confirm the stage count: at N=3 (r=3.684) outlet T=429.9K>420K, at N=4 (r=2.659) outlet T=396.0K<420K. All 4 stages/coolers solved with mass_rel_err=0 and energy_rel_err<5e-9. W_total = N x first-stage power = 4 x 36.318 kW = 145.27 kW (per card's requested approximation; the sum of the actual 4 distinct stage duties is 143.48 kW).

Feed stream (natural gas, given composition) at 30 bar fed to a separator; swept T in the Feed stream spec and read vapor_fraction, bracketing and refining to the VF=0.5 crossing. Final solve at T=189.05 K gives VF=0.50005, mass_rel_err~9e-6, energy_rel_err~9e-6.

Built counter-current heat_exchanger (SteamTables) with hot_in 5 kg/s water 450 K/10 bar, cold_in 8 kg/s water 298 K/1 atm, zero ΔP both sides. Swept UA to hit cold_out T=330 K, refined to UA=9647.586 W/K; final solve gives cold_out=330.0002 K, hot_out=400.44 K, energy_rel_err=8.5e-10, mass/compound residuals=0.

Built Mixer(Fresh+RecycledStream)->Heater(400K)->Splitter(purge, SplitRecycle)->Recycle1 closing loop to Mixer. Swept Splitter1.split_ratio_0 and interpolated/verified at p=10/35=0.285714, giving SplitRecycle=RecycledStream=25.000 kg/s and Purge=10.000 kg/s (= fresh feed, as the overall steady-state balance requires). Mass/energy residuals <1e-8.

Feed 1 mol/s at 230 K, 30 bar flashed in a separator (Peng-Robinson, 7 compounds). Sep1 mass_rel_err=3.2e-6, compound_max_rel_err=2.4e-5, energy_rel_err=3.2e-6. VF and compositions read from solved Vapor/Liquid streams.

Shortcut (FUG) column: light key Propane, heavy key N-butane, lk_in_bottoms=0.02, hk_in_distillate=0.02, Pc=16 bar, Pr=17.5 bar, R=1.8404. Mass_rel_err~4e-6, compound_max_rel_err~1e-5, energy_rel_err~1e-16. D, Qc, Qr, N_min, R_min, N read directly from read_unit on the solved column.

Heat exchanger (pinch/UA mode, UA=2500 W/K, hot_dP=0.2 bar, cold_dP=0.1 bar) with hot water 5 kg/s @450K/10bar and cold water 8 kg/s @298K/10bar, SteamTables property package. mass_rel_err=0, energy_rel_err=2.8e-11.

Mixer MIX1 combining Feed1 (100 mol/s, 280 K, 20 bar, 90/8/2% C1/C2/C3) and Feed2 (50 mol/s, 340 K, 22 bar, 50/30/20%) with PengRobinson. Outlet P set by the solver to 20 bar (min of inlets, since a mixer cannot raise pressure). Max compound residual ~1e-16, energy residual ~3e-10.

CH4 (1 mol/s) + stoichiometric air (2 O2 + 7.52 N2 = 9.52 mol/s) mixed at 500 K/1 atm, fed to an isothermal conversion reactor (CH4+2O2->CO2+2H2O, 100% conversion). Mass and energy residuals ~0; Q read from REACTOR duty_kW; y_CO2, y_CH4 read from flue_vapor (flue_liquid stream is empty, all vapor).
Equilibrium reactor (Peng-Robinson), equimolar CO+H2O feed 10 mol/s at 600K/1atm, lnK=4577.8/T-4.33, isothermal. mass_rel_err~2.4e-16, energy_rel_err~1.9e-15. y_H2 and Q read from R1/VaporOut.

Built mixer->heater(outlet 400K)->splitter(0.2/0.8)->recycle unit (Wegstein) feeding back to mixer, fresh water 10 kg/s. Purge=10 kg/s matches fresh feed (steady-state closure), recycle=40 kg/s (4x purge from 80/20 split).

Built a single flash separator (DWSIM Vessel) fed with 100 mol/s C1/C2/nC5/nC7 (70/10/10/10%) at 290 K, 20 bar, PengRobinson EOS. VF_feed, y_CH4 (vapor) and x_C7 (liquid) read from the solved Vapor/Liquid streams; mass_rel_err≈2.4e-5, energy_rel_err≈2.4e-5.

Feed stream (85/7/4/2% C1/C2/C3/nC4 + 2% CO2, 100 mol/s, 300 K, 50 bar) through an isenthalpic valve to 10 bar, Peng-Robinson. Mass rel err ~0, energy rel err ~4e-11. Read T_out from the Out stream; stream remains vapor (vapor_fraction=1) after expansion.
